item.title: Patriotic Acts Across America Bring New Optimism
Lawsuit Challenges Trump's Paid Priority Access on Truth Social
item.description: A federal lawsuit filed Wednesday alleges that a Truth Social feature giving paying users faster access to Trump's posts is unlawful.

item.title: Federal Authorities Dismantle Major Marriage Fraud Ring Involving Over 1,000 Sham Unions
item.description: Eleven defendants face charges in a scheme that arranged more than 1,000 fraudulent marriages for Chinese nationals seeking green cards.

item.title: Scott Accuses El-Sayed of Supporting Hamas Over America
item.description: Senator Tim Scott claims Abdul El-Sayed is 'for Hamas' and anti-American, as Mike Rogers campaigns for Michigan's open Senate seat.
